args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.0) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Incident opened to track and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, and v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out, and the service now reports **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the rollback to v2.3.0 and noting the need to investigate the v2.3.1 regression. The on-call engineer was paged.
